title: Code Evolver | From data to an evolution
text: Welcome to Code Evolver. Turn feedback into a focused code improvement workflow. This demonstration uses simulated data. No real agents or repository changes are involved.

title: Upload feedback and run the analyzer team
text: First, upload customer feedback and start the analyzer team. The analysis identifies checkout timeouts and unclear error messages, then recommends better recovery actions and focused tests.

title: Apply the recommendation and create an evolution
text: Apply the recommendation to the evolution form. Choose the checkout scope and target branch, then create an evolution. The saved task is now ready to start.

title: Start the evolution and follow live agent activity
text: Start the evolution to follow its progress. The scan and planning stages prepare a work item. The worker stage shows live activity as it handles checkout recovery.

title: Review the change and run the quality gate
text: Next, the review and quality gate stages check the proposed change. Agent status and the event timeline make progress and results visible in one place.

title: Completed | Inspect the work item and event history
text: The simulated evolution is complete. Inspect the finished work item and event history. In this demo, no files, commits, pushes, or pull requests were created.
